atAGlance: Nước ngọt is the Vietnamese catch-all for soft drinks, sweet, fizzy, and usually served cold or over ice.
whatItIs: Nước ngọt is a soda or bottled sweet drink. Expect soft drink, sweet, fizzy, and familiar, usually served cold or over ice.
howToEnjoy: Use the brand name if you know it; nước ngọt is the category word.
howLocalsOrder: Nước ngọt is ordered by cold bottle, can, or glass, then by ice. Ask không đá or ít đá early, because many casual places pour drinks over ice by default.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nước ngọt is the Vietnamese catch-all for sweet bottled or canned soft drinks.
goodToKnow: May come with a glass of ice.
